research_notes: The next strict target should not be scheduled by changing the current pre-armed wake at close; the successor invocation itself will pre-arm its own continuation after reconciling state.
This preserves the one-scheduler-write-per-invocation strict protocol.
The current wake therefore remains tied to this probe's target+gap, not the next probe's eventual target.
At successor start, fresh state will select 16m only if this close is clean.
This avoids scheduler races and keeps ownership of scheduling local to the new active invocation.
No close-time scheduler mutation is allowed.
